rationale: The measured 1.3.6-rc1 reference is the first baseline validated by the current output-signature and clean-machine dependency gates. Tagged 1.3.2-1.3.5 Full installers omitted load-bearing AVIF and JPEG XL writer files and are not valid no-regression baselines. Keep later releases within 128 KiB compressed and 256 KiB for each raw payload unless an explicit reviewed policy change records why. 2026-07-31: reviewed policy change — rustPayloadGrowthAllowanceBytes raised 262,144 → 1,094,144 (max 22,478,336 → 23,310,336; measured 23,048,192 = +832,000 vs the 1.3.6-rc1 reference, +256 KiB slack). Cause: the Lepton (.lep) DECODE feature — the vendored lepton_jpeg crate (decode tier + crash-hardening patches) is load-bearing in the shipped DLL/EXE. Verified against CI run 30635355445 (production payload size gate).
